title: Evaluating Neural Probabilistic Forecasts of Sparse Earthquake Counts: What Survives a Careful Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2605.21437v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We revisit a neural negative binomial model for weekly earthquake counts on a 3 x 3 degree grid over the Tian Shan and Pamir, and ask which of its conclusions survive a careful evaluation. At the completeness magnitude of 4.5, the 144-week test period holds 2448 cell-weeks; six cell-weeks, in five distinct weeks, have three or more events.   Two conclusions survive. First, Poisson forecasts, temporal ETAS included, understate the probability of such a busy week: ETAS expects 0.72 where six occurred, a shortfall by a factor of 8.3 (p = 0.00009, exact test). One dispersion parameter removes it (ETAS with dispersion expects 4.45, p = 0.58); simulating aftershock chains within the week also reproduces the tail but overshoots the total count by about a quarter. translated_title: 评估稀疏地震计数的神经概率预报：哪些结论能经受严格评估的检验
translated_abstract: 我们重新审视了一个用于天山与帕米尔地区3×3度网格上每周地震计数的神经负二项模型，并探究其哪些结论能够经受住严格评估的检验。在完整性震级为4.5的条件下，144周的测试期共包含2448个网格-周单元；其中六个网格-周（分布在五个不同的周内）发生了三次及以上的地震事件。有两个结论得以保留。首先，泊松类预报（包括时间性ETAS模型）显著低估了出现这种“繁忙周”的概率：在实际发生六次事件的情况下，ETAS模型的预期仅为0.72次，低估达8.3倍（p = 0.00009，精确检验）。仅需引入一个离散（过散布）参数即可消除这一偏差（带离散参数的ETAS预期为4.45次，p = 0.58）；而在周内模拟余震链虽能再现该尾部特征，却会使总计数超出约四分之一。其次，一旦线性模型为每个网格单元设置了各自的截距项，神经网络相对于线性模型的优势便不复存在：剩余增益仅为偏差的3.4%，不具统计显著性（p = 0.57）。
tldr: 对天山-帕米尔地区周地震计数神经概率预报的严格评估表明：泊松类预报（含ETAS）严重低估单周发生3次以上地震的概率（低估8.3倍），引入一个离散参数即可解决；而神经网络相对线性模型的优势在为每个网格加入截距后便不再显著。
en_tdlr: A rigorous evaluation of neural probabilistic forecasts of weekly earthquake counts in the Tian Shan–Pamir region shows that Poisson-based forecasts (including ETAS) underestimate the probability of weeks with three or more events by a factor of 8.3—a gap closable with a single dispersion parameter—while the neural network's advantage over a linear model becomes insignificant once per-cell intercepts are added.
